T: Never send a man to do a kid's job.
D: A club of monster-mad kids gets Van Helsing's diary and has until midnight to send Dracula and his monsters into limbo.
P: Serve the subs when Horace kicks the Wolf Man in the nards.
S: Garlic pizza scrolls with three cheeses
Garlic pizza straight to a vampire's face

Cut the top off the garlic bulb, drizzle with oil, wrap in foil and roast at 200C until soft. Squeeze the garlic out and mash it with the butter and parsley. Spread each pastry sheet with tomato paste, then the garlic butter, oregano and cheeses. Roll up tightly, cut into 2cm rounds and lay them flat on a lined tray. Bake at 200C until puffed, golden and bubbling.
Black Lagoon fish bites with tartare
Crumbed fish bites with tartare. Gill-man down. My name is Horace.

Stir the mayonnaise, capers, gherkins and a squeeze of lemon into a tartare. Dip the fish in seasoned flour, beaten egg, then panko. Shallow-fry in batches in hot oil until golden and just cooked. Drain and serve with the tartare and lemon wedges.
500g flathead fillets, cut in bite-size pieces@Seafood
M: Wolf Man meatball subs with provolone
Meatball subs with melted provolone. Kick him in the nards, Horace.

Mix the mince, egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan and half the garlic, then roll into 16 balls. Brown the meatballs in the oil and lift them out. Soften the onion and the rest of the garlic, add the passata and oregano, return the meatballs and simmer until cooked through. Split the rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce, lay over the provolone and grill until melted. Tear over the basil and serve.
Scary German Guy's bratwurst and kraut
Bratwurst with caraway sauerkraut. Scary German Guy translates Van Helsing's diary.

Cook the onion slowly in the butter until soft, then add the sauerkraut and caraway and warm through. Grill the bratwurst over medium heat, turning, until browned and cooked through. Split the rolls, add the kraut and bratwurst and finish with mustard.
W: Scary German Guy serves the boys pie

Cook the apples with the sugar, cinnamon, lemon juice and butter until just tender, then stir in the cornflour and cool. Line a 23cm pie dish with one pastry sheet and fill with the apples. Lay over the second sheet, crimp the edges, cut steam holes and brush with egg. Bake at 200C until deep golden and bubbling, then rest 15 minutes. Cut big wedges and serve with thick cream.
6 granny smith apples, peeled and sliced@Produce
K: Cherry cola poured over ice cream, for the amulet of concentrated goodness
Put two scoops of ice cream in each tall glass. Pour the cola slowly down the side so it foams up, then top with a cherry.
